STP.note: Digital identity transition announced; no authentication, e-signature or PKI service is stated.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding an ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Pilot with MOSIP is mentioned but nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.

facts.fact: The Director of Registries and Notaries says a first-phase single identity card is planned to bring together civil identification, tax, social security, health and electoral commission information.
The Director of Registries and Notaries says a pilot project with MOSIP is preparing the digital identity, with the physical card still unfunded.
